unstated.what: Hamiltonian.__add__ and Hamiltonian.__iadd__ must treat numeric 0 as the identity (H + 0, H += 0) instead of raising. The pasted sketch only adds the zero guard to Observable.__add__. Hamiltonian overrides both methods and does not call super, so the Observable guard does not cover them. Grep for def __add__/def __iadd__ finds the pair; the same zero guard fixes both.

instruction_covers: sum of Pauli observables starting at integer 0 must work, which requires Observable.__radd__ as well as the sketched __add__ zero guard
obs + 0 and obs + 0.0 return the observable; the sketch uses numbers.Number and other == 0
Tensor inherits Observable, so Tensor + 0 and 0 + Tensor follow from the Observable guards
Nonzero numeric add still raises; obs + obs still builds a Hamiltonian
notes: 0 + Hamiltonian and sum of Hamiltonians pass if Observable.__radd__ returns self, because Hamiltonian does not override __radd__. Only the forward and in-place Hamiltonian adds are extra. Tests accept ValueError or TypeError for nonzero add, matching the existing ValueError.
